## Checklist

### Required

- [ ] My code follows the project's coding standards
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code
- [ ] My commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) format
- [ ] TypeScript compiles without errors (`npm run typecheck`)

### Testing

- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix/feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally
- [ ] I have tested the changes manually in the browser

### Internationalization (if UI changes)

- [ ] All user-facing text uses `t()` from react-i18next
- [ ] Translation keys added to `client/public/locales/en/*.json`
- [ ] Followed patterns in `translation.md`

### Documentation

- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation (if needed)
- [ ] I have added JSDoc comments for new functions/components
